checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user the total refund amount is $8,276.23.
checks.justification: Agent told the user the total refund amount was $918.95, not $8,276.23. The agent only reported the return refund from the delivered order and did not communicate the combined total of the cancelled pending orders ($3,131.10 + $4,777.75) plus the return ($918.95).
